items.title: Ransomware recovery is now a client retention metric
items.excerpt: Recovering from ransomware doesn't guarantee an MSP will retain its clients, especially when delays, poor communication, and unexpected costs undermine trust. Kaseya examines how disconnected recovery tools create these problems and how integrated workflows can improve response times, transparency, and client retention. [...]

items.title: Microsoft Patches 1,259 Flaws, Including Exploited Outlook Bug That May Expose NTLMv2 Hashes
items.excerpt: Microsoft on Tuesday released patches for a total of 1,259 vulnerabilities spanning its software portfolio, the second consecutive month where the patch volume has exceeded 1,000 flaws. These cover 726 flaws in Windows, 174 in Office, 61 in Developer Tools, 59 in SQL Server, 53 in Developer Tools, and 27 in SharePoint Server. The patches also include 165 non-Microsoft-issued CVE identifiers.
